heading: Frequently Asked Questions
copy: Have questions about timelines, licensing, or deliveries? Find all the answers here.
bottomCtaHeading: Ready to ignite the spark of your story?
bottomCtaCopy: If you have an idea in mind or need a custom quote for a special project, write to me and let’s shape it together.

questions.heading: Do you use Artificial Intelligence (AI) in your artwork?
questions.copy: No, at no stage of the process. Every piece is drawn and painted by hand stroke by stroke using digital painting software (Photoshop / Clip Studio Paint) from original sketches. If your project or publisher requires proof of 100% human authorship, layered source files and process snapshots can be provided.

questions.heading: Do I need to have a clear idea, or can you help me define it?
questions.copy: You don’t need to have everything fully defined. You can share anything from a concrete description to an emotion or memory you’d like to capture. The more details and references you provide, the closer the result will be to your vision. At Auralis, collaboration is essential to transform a spark of inspiration into a fully realized world.

questions.heading: How long does it take to complete an illustration?
questions.copy: Every piece is handcrafted with dedication, so the timeline depends on complexity, detail, and format (typically between 1 and 4 weeks, as shown on each card in the Services section above). Before starting, you will always receive a clear estimated schedule for your project.

questions.heading: Can I commission a character based on myself, my pet, or my OC?
questions.copy: Absolutely! Whether it’s a fantasy portrait of you or someone special, a magical tribute to your pet, or your original character (OC) from an RPG campaign or novel, I can bring them to life within the atmosphere of Auralis.

questions.heading: Can you adapt your style to different aesthetics?
questions.copy: My style has its own essence and narrative, but there is flexibility to adjust it in order to align with your vision. Together, we will find the balance between your idea and the artistic identity of Auralis.

questions.heading: Do you accept fanart commissions?
questions.copy: Yes! I love reimagining characters and scenes from your favorite books, campaigns, films, or video games through the light and aesthetic of Auralis.

questions.heading: How is the price of an illustration calculated?
questions.copy: Every project is unique, so quotes are tailored according to the type of artwork, number of characters, background complexity, and level of detail. In the Services section above, you can check the starting rates for each category. If your project requires a custom scope or a multi-piece bundle, reach out for a personalized proposal.

questions.heading: How do payments work?
questions.copy:
I offer two payment modalities to suit your comfort:

Single payment (recommended): The total amount is paid once all commission details are confirmed. This streamlines the workflow and allows me to share high-resolution progress updates without watermarks.

Staged payment:
1. 20% deposit before starting the initial sketch.
2. 50% upon sketch approval (progress previews carry a watermark during this stage).
3. 30% final balance upon completion, prior to sending the high-resolution master files.

Accepted methods: PayPal, Payoneer, MercadoPago, and bank transfer.

questions.heading: Do you offer refunds?
questions.copy: Because every artwork is custom-made and requires dedicated time, refunds are not available once work has begun. However, our collaborative process includes clear review milestones during the sketch and coloring phases to ensure you are thrilled with the final result.

questions.heading: Is the illustration for personal use only, or does it include commercial rights?
questions.copy: By default, commissions include a personal use license (personal social media, private RPG campaigns, personal prints, or gifts). If you intend to use the artwork commercially—such as a published book cover, indie game, streaming brand, or merchandise—please mention it in your inquiry so we can include the appropriate commercial license.

questions.heading: Can I request modifications after the artwork is finished?
questions.copy: Yes, post-delivery adjustments are possible for an additional fee depending on complexity. To protect your budget, I always recommend finalizing major structural changes during the sketch stage.

questions.heading: In what formats will I receive the artwork?
questions.copy:
All pieces are delivered in master digital quality, ready for both screens and fine art printing:

• Formats: High-quality PNG, JPG, and PDF (upon request).
• Color profiles: RGB (digital) or CMYK (print).
• Resolution: 300 DPI in generous dimensions.

questions.heading: Do you offer physical shipping or digital delivery?
questions.copy: At the moment, all deliveries are 100% digital at 300 DPI resolution, professionally prepared so you can print them at your trusted local print shop without losing a single glimmer of detail.

questions.heading: Do you work with international clients?
questions.copy: Yes! Auralis is a borderless atelier open to dreamers, authors, and creators from every corner of the world.
